data.name: Core.Error.Corrupt
data.value: The file "{0}" is damaged or is not a PDF document.

data.name: Core.Error.PermissionDenied
data.value: This operation is not allowed by the document's security settings.

data.name: Core.Error.NotImplemented
data.value: This feature is not available yet.

data.name: Core.Password.Prompt
data.value: The document "{0}" is protected. Enter the password:

data.name: Core.Encryption.ResaveOwnerOnly
data.value: The document was opened with the owner password and the original open password is unknown. When saving, the owner password will also be used as the open password. You can change this in Protect > Password Protection.

data.name: Core.Error.FolderNotFound
data.value: The folder for “{0}” does not exist or is not available.

data.name: Core.Error.AccessDenied
data.value: Access to “{0}” was denied (the file may be read-only or you lack permissions).

data.name: Core.Error.FileInUse
data.value: Cannot read or write “{0}”. The file may be open in another program or the drive may be unavailable.

data.name: Core.Error.Clipboard
data.value: The clipboard is not available right now (another program is using it). Try again.

data.name: Core.Error.InvalidFormat
data.value: The file or data has an invalid or unsupported format.

data.name: Core.Error.Cryptography
data.value: A cryptographic operation failed (certificate, key or signature).

data.name: Core.Error.OutOfMemory
data.value: Not enough memory to complete the operation.

data.name: Core.Error.Unexpected
data.value: The operation failed because of an unexpected error. Technical details are below and in the log file.

data.name: Core.Error.FileTooLarge
data.value: The file “{0}” is {1} MB. ZetPDF opens files up to {2} MB because the whole document is kept in memory.

data.name: Core.Error.NoFilePath
data.value: The document has no file yet – use Save As.

data.name: Core.Error.NeverSaved
data.value: The document has never been saved, so there is no version on disk to revert to.

data.name: Core.Error.TooComplex
data.value: The file is damaged or too complex to open safely.

data.name: Core.Error.ContentTooLarge
data.value: The document content is too large after decompression and was not processed.

data.name: Core.Error.ProbeIncomplete
data.value: The file could not be fully checked in the allotted time and was skipped.

data.name: Core.Probe.Incomplete
data.value: The file could not be fully checked in the allotted time. Open it anyway? A file from an untrusted source may close the program; unsaved changes are protected by auto-save.
